name: Locker with combination lock
prompt: A four-digit combination lock. Someone has scratched into the paint: 'Same as always – her birth year.'
solved_text: Click! The locker swings open. Inside: a crowbar.
wrong_text: The lock beeps red. Wrong code.

name: Power circuit
prompt: An open wall panel with four sockets and four loose cables. Plug the right cable into each socket.
solved_text: Sparks, a hum – a compartment pops open. Inside lies an access card.
wrong_text: A brief crackle, then nothing. The order is wrong.
